canDoYue: 你識打電話訂位，改時間，同確認個名。
canDoEn: Book a table by phone, change the time, and confirm the name.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Good evening. A table for Mei, please. Is a window seat free tonight?
dialogue.glossYue: 你好。我想幫 Mei 訂檯，今晚仲有冇靠窗位？
dialogue.say: Good evening. A table for Mei, please. Is a window seat free tonight?

dialogue.speaker: ana
dialogue.text: Yes. The window seat for Mei fits a party of four.
dialogue.glossYue: 得。Mei 可以坐四人靠窗位。
dialogue.say: Yes. The window seat for Mei fits a party of four.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Could we change the time and keep the reservation if we arrive later?
dialogue.glossYue: 可唔可以改時間，如果我哋遲啲到，訂位仲留住？
dialogue.say: Could we change the time and keep the reservation if we arrive later?

dialogue.speaker: ana
dialogue.text: I can change the time to eight, and the indoor seat stays free.
dialogue.glossYue: 我可以將時間改到八點，室內位仍然留低。
dialogue.say: I can change the time to eight, and the indoor seat stays free.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: If it rains, please cancel the outdoor seat and keep us indoors.
dialogue.glossYue: 如果落雨，請取消室外位，留我哋喺室內。
dialogue.say: If it rains, please cancel the outdoor seat and keep us indoors.

dialogue.speaker: ana
dialogue.text: Those patio seats are booked, but I can add you to the waitlist.
dialogue.glossYue: 室外位已經滿咗，但我可以將你哋放上候補。
dialogue.say: Those patio seats are booked, but I can add you to the waitlist.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Please confirm the booking, and what time do we come?
dialogue.glossYue: 請確認訂位，我哋大概幾點嚟？
dialogue.say: Please confirm the booking, and what time do we come?

dialogue.speaker: ana
dialogue.text: I will hold the booking until eight, and send a short note.
dialogue.glossYue: 我會留住個訂位到八點，再寄一則短訊。
dialogue.say: I will hold the booking until eight, and send a short note.
